 Noble man uses sham farm stand to steal $212K in SNAP benefits 
 BY MIKE W. RAY
mike.ray@swoknews.com 
 Mike Ray 
 Senior Wrtier

 4 hrs ago

 OKLAHOMA CITY — A Noble man pleaded guilty last week to theft of government property and Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits fraud.
 Steven Eugene Melton Jr., 41, applied to the U.S. Department of Agriculture’s Food and Nutrition Service in 2023 for authorization to accept SNAP benefits at a purported farmers market called Wrights Farms. In the application he requested approval to accept SNAP electronic benefit transfer benefits as a “direct marketing farmer,” also referred to as a farm stand.
